original.target_description: Partner relative-capability ratings: 2 (encouragement versus no encouragement) by 2 (sex) ANOVA, condition main effect, partner conditions only.

notes: Partner capability condition main effect extracted separately from the sex interaction and sex main effect. Replication title and DOI verified against publisher metadata, but accessible material was abstract-only. Publisher full-text route returned 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex supplied no OA full text; targeted repository/preprint searches and author Academia profile supplied no accessible full text.
